plan.purpose: For someone checking an expense: they've just turned a receipt or bill into data and want to see what it cost, who it's from and whether the reading is right, then file it.
plan.title: Your invoice, read and ready to file
plan.composition: The page uses the full width and reads like a compact accounting ledger. It is dense and exact, without decoration. ResultHeader opens the page and carries the only h1. Below it, a short DataTable ledger gives one line per extracted invoice, so a run with several documents shows them all at once. Then each invoice in /result repeats as its own flat Section, separated by hairlines and never boxed. Inside each Section, the money comes first and largest: a band of three Fact tiles in a Grid, with the total including tax first. Below the band, a Split at 2:1 puts the record beside who was involved: the purchase details on the left and the seller and buyer on the right. The raw extracted text is for checking only, so it sits folded in a Collapsible at the foot of each invoice. No figure gets a unit, because the state carries no currency.

brief:
# Result page: invoice_extraction.process_invoice

Process relevant information from an invoice

## Frame

This page is the result page of an app that is composed, then shows its result: what the person sees after one run. The host draws what surrounds it: the band with the team's logo and the app's name, then a bar restating the request with a way back to edit it and to run again. The host also owns the actions on the result, such as downloading or sharing it, and places them where the page's header puts them. There is no side panel, no app bar and no footer to build, and nothing restates the request.

The page is the result across the full width. It opens on its header, which names the result in a person's words, read from the result itself where it can be (the page's h1). Then the figure or the fact a person looks for first, then the body of the result in the shape it naturally has: a plan day by day, options side by side to compare, a record's details. Lay out what a person reads; leave out what only a machine would.

## State

The host loads the run's result under `/result` before the page renders. Read every value with `$state`; emit no `/state` patches. Paths:

- `/result` — list of structure invoice_extraction.Invoice — `output`: Invoice information extracted from text, supporting both formal bills and receipts
  - each item is a structure invoice_extraction.Invoice (Invoice information extracted from text, supporting both formal bills and receipts), with these members (paths relative to one item, for DataTable columns or $item):
    - `invoice_id` — text — `invoice_id`: Unique identifier for the invoice
    - `invoice_number` — text — `invoice_number`: Invoice number as shown on the document
    - `issue_date` — date — `issue_date`: Date when the invoice was issued
    - `time` — text — `time`: Time of the transaction if available
    - `amount_incl_tax` — number — `amount_incl_tax`: Total amount including taxes
    - `amount_excl_tax` — number — `amount_excl_tax`: Net amount excluding taxes
    - `vat_amount` — number — `vat_amount`: Total VAT/tax amount
    - `vat_rates` — list of number — `vat_rates`: List of VAT rates applied
      - each item is a number
    - `vendor` — text — `vendor`: Name of the vendor/seller
    - `vendor_address` — text — `vendor_address`: Complete address of the vendor
    - `vendor_siret` — text — `vendor_siret`: SIRET number of the vendor (French company registration)
    - `vendor_vat_number` — text — `vendor_vat_number`: VAT registration number of the vendor
    - `company_name` — text — `company_name`: Name of the purchasing company
    - `company_address` — text — `company_address`: Address of the purchasing company
    - `description` — text — `description`: Description of goods or services purchased
    - `category` — structure invoice_extraction.InvoiceDetails — `category`: Category or type of expense
      - `category/category` — choice of "bill" | "receipt" — `category`: The category of the invoice
      - `category/explanation` — text — `explanation`: Explanation of the classification
    - `text` — text — `text`: Raw text extracted from the invoice

## Delegated

None. `MthdsResult` remains available for any structure you choose not to lay out.

## One real run, as loaded

The state of one actual run, so you can judge magnitudes and lengths. Bind to the paths; do not copy these values into the spec.
